a family‐32 CBM directly participated in the recognition of mannotetraoses by the family‐5 GH domain of CtMan5.
a family‐32 CBM is essential for the recognition of mannotetraoside substrates in the family‐5 GH of CtMan5.

the role of a family 32 CBM in substrate recognition by a GH5 mannanase.
the importance of CBM in the catalytic activity of CtMan5.
the role of CBM32 of CtMan5 in substrate recognition.

CBM32 plays an essential role in substrate recognition by GH5.
the family‐32 CBM of CtMan5B, as a part of the substrate‐binding site, plays an important role in the substrate recognition by CtMann5B.

CBM32 is essential in substrate recognition by mannanase CtMann5A, and that CBM32‐mediated substrate recognition is a key factor for efficient catalytic action of the enzyme.
